prompt: A traveler sits on the rubble beneath the tall columns, sketching. Write the letter he sends home that evening describing what he saw.
The red sail and the pale sail are heading out together across calm water. Write the conversation between the two boats' crews as they row.
Two figures stand on the rocks, looking at the sea and the great stone arch. Describe the sounds, smells, and feel of the air at that edge of the water.
Two cows lie in the grass, one russet and one spotted. Write a short poem about an unhurried afternoon of doing nothing at all.
A man rests on a veranda while a woman and child sit nearby, a basket beside them. What are they talking about as the day goes by?
The woman holds a folded letter close to her chest. Write the letter she has just read, or the one she is about to write back.
A candle, a violin, open books, and a pair of globes crowd the table. List the objects on your own desk and what each one says about you.
Travelers carry a palanquin down the road past thatched roofs, with a snowy mountain behind a great pine. Write what the weary travelers hope to find at the next inn.
A swarm of bees has settled in the tree, and the whole farmyard has come out to deal with it. Write the scene as the farmer's neighbor tells it later.
One small white house glows among the autumn trees. Write about who is inside and what they are cooking for supper.
The boat sits alone on green water with a single tall mast. Write from the point of view of the boat, telling where it has been.
A dry riverbed of pale stones winds toward the trees and distant hills. Write about a place from your past where you used to walk on your own.
Bold red flowers and curling leaves fill the pattern, drawn on a grid. Write about a garden, real or invented, that you would plant in just these colors.
A young woman in a blue skirt kneels to milk a goat while a donkey and sheep wait nearby. Describe the scene using sound, smell, and touch.
A full moon hangs over the willows as a boatman poles a heap of cargo along the river. What happened just before this crossing began?
Grapes, lemons, pears, and apples sit in swirling light. Write about a meal you remember in which the fruit was the best part.
Women in long white dresses wade at the edge of the foam on a bright sunny day. Write about a day at the shore from your own life.
The young woman wears a huge lace collar and an orange and black gown. Write her thoughts as she waits, perfectly still, for the portrait to be done.
One small steamboat crosses a wide, glittering sea under a pale sky. Write what the person at the rail is thinking as the shore slips away.
The ship flies a yellow flag and a long red streamer from its tall masts. Write a list of the cargo and passengers it carries.
Two women hold up a cloth painted with a snowy mountain while another woman sits watching. What was said just after the cloth was unfolded?
A horse and cart wait in a sunny, nearly empty street. Write about a street you knew well as a child and who lived on it.
A girl in a dark dress sits with her arms folded and a small book beside her. Write what she hopes to do when she is allowed to move again.
The man holds a pen as if he has just paused mid-sentence. Write the sentence he was in the middle of writing.
A woman in a wide hat holds her umbrella against the falling snow beside a bamboo grove. Write about the sounds of a winter walk you remember.
The woman in the white cap has a small, knowing smile and a gold bow at her neck. Write the letter she would send to a close friend today.
A lute, a sword, a blue and white jar, and a rich red carpet fill the room, but no one is there. Where has everyone gone, and when are they coming back?
The woman rests her cheek on her hand with a brush at her lips, as if thinking of the next word. Write the poem she is composing.
A woman carries a tray with two flower vases while two others arrange a tall plant. Write the conversation in the room as the preparations go on.
A small group in long robes walks across the plaza toward a grand gate. Write what the youngest member of the group is noticing along the way.
